definitions.gloss: picking up and dropping off; transportation to and from
definitions.explanation: The act of taking someone to a destination and bringing them back, or more broadly, providing rides both ways. Very common in the context of children, elderly care, and daily commuting.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{送|おく}り{迎|むか}え⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To pick up and drop off the children.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{送|おく}り{迎|むか}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧だ。
examples.english: The daily school run is exhausting.

examples.english: It would be a great help to have someone who can drive me to and from the station.

notes:
USAGE:
{送|おく}り{迎|むか}え combines {送|おく}り (sending/taking someone) and ⟦{迎|むか}え→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧ (picking up/meeting someone) into one word meaning round-trip transportation.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{送|おく}り{迎|むか}え⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to do the pickup and drop-off for...)
- ⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{送|おく}り{迎|むか}え (transportation to and from...)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{送|おく}り{迎|むか}え (school run for children)
- {送|おく}り{迎|むか}え⟦バス→バス：00769_basu⟧ (shuttle bus)
- {送|おく}り{迎|むか}え⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧ (pickup and drop-off service)

This word is especially common among parents discussing daily routines with childcare and school.
